caller_tactics.text: Good afternoon, Eszter? It's Russell Vance from Golden Meridian Bullion Trust. Do you have a minute?
Gold, Eszter. Gold coins that are about to triple in value. Our clients who bought last year are very pleased.
Normally, yes. But the mine supplying our coins is Ardent Gold Mines, ticker A R D G, and its shares are up thirty percent this month alone.
They supply our bullion, which is why our coins are about to triple. The gold price is guaranteed to climb once the new mine opens.
Our coins are, Eszter, and I've seen the model myself. Any investor who waits will miss the entire rise.
A starter set is eight thousand dollars. Eight thousand today locks in the price for the whole run.
I'm afraid not. The price is only held until four o'clock today. After that, it goes back to the normal market.
There's no need for that. Most of our customers buy over the phone, and the paperwork is just a formality.
Eszter, the people who waited last year regretted it badly. Shall I reserve the starter set for you now?
